end.summary:
Predicted that objects with curved surfaces roll; this was shown with why/new-situation questions.
Practised predicting that objects with flat faces slide; easy questions were right, with why/new-situation questions still to check.
Practised predicting that objects with flat tops and bottoms stack; easy questions were right, with why/new-situation questions still to check.
No misconception was recorded; the lesson ended when Anika asked to change activity because they felt tired.
end.parentNote: Anika practised sorting objects by whether they roll, slide, or stack. They used the shape of a ball, bottle, drum, and box to explain their predictions; curved surfaces rolling was shown, while slide and stack predictions still need a why or new-situation check. No mix-up was recorded or corrected later. At home, ask Anika to predict what a few safe household objects will do on a gentle slope and ask, “Why?”
